maya: Morning — quick FYI: our APAC GCP burst credits for project falcon are at ~95% and demo tomorrow 09:00 SGT. Can we do a short-lived SKU shift to smaller instance types + request vendor top-up? Anyone with direct GCP rep contact? :eyes:

anil: I have the rep — Mei Chen (meichen@gcp-partner). Opened ticket 123456789, asked for temporary credits and quota bump for compute.googleapis.com. ETA 6-12h. I’ll paste link when they reply.

liam: If we switch to n2-standard for the canary, perf drop is ~8% but cost saves 30%. For quick switch we can do:

```
# quick patch to instance group
gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-instance-template my-group \
  --template=n2-template --zone=asia-southeast1-a
```

liam: Then scale down GPUs in the pool by 20% for the night window.

sophia: Thanks — can you add a short rollback plan? I’ll own the demo routing if we need to fallback to eu-west1.

anil: Re rollback: if perf > 12% worse we flip traffic back to eu-west1 and apply rate-limiting. I’ll update runbook.

ops-bot: [automated] quota-alert: project/falcon compute.googleapis.com usage at 95% of monthly burst credit.

maya: Awesome. @anil please ping Mei and drop the ticket link here. @liam can you prepare the instance-template PR and tag me for review? I’ll coordinate demo routing with sophia.

anil: pinged Mei. ticket: https://gcp.support/ticket/123456789 — she asked for our billing alias and expected peak QPS, sent now.

liam: PR is up — #repo PR 834. Quick perf smoke will be on staging in 20m.

sophia: I’ll prep the traffic switch doc and have a one-click runbook in case the UE spike hits. Will monitor from 08:30 SGT.

maya: Thanks all — will update if vendor confirms credits. :thumbsup:
